parties.petitioner: Godrej And Boyce Manufacturing Company Limited
parties.respondent: The Municipal Corporation Of Greater Mumbai

summary: Dispute over Additional TDR (Amenity TDR) grant for Recreation Ground surrender; interpretation of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 s.126(1)(b); validity of MCGB Circulars restricting TDR; claim rejected by HC on grounds of non-application under Regulation 34 clause 6, abandonment, improper authority; appeal challenges findings on procedural compliance, development completion, and entitlement to additional TDR.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act, 1966 s.126(1)(b)
Development Control Regulations for Greater Mumbai, 1991 Regulation 34 Appendix VII clause 6
final_judgment: Under examination; not explicitly stated in excerpt.
